summary: A strong, honest Phase 2 artifact. The three required sample sets are genuinely recorded, redistributable, offline audio: public/samples/grand holds 90 real MP3s (30 roots x 3 distinct velocity layers, ~300KB each, ID3/MPEG verified), and public/samples/{upright,electric} hold 19 real MP3s each; md5 confirms grand/upright/electric and grand's three velocity layers are all distinct files, and render-library.test.ts proves the three are audibly distinct (similarity < 0.8, zero-crossing spread > 1.15) through the real graph. IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json declares provenance/licenses truthfully (Salamander CC BY 3.0; MIDI-JS Soundfonts MIT) and honestly flags single-layer velocity shaping and generated reverb/resonance/pedal-noise buffers as DSP, never as recordings. The audio graph is exemplary: one AudioContext, per-layer voice buses -> timbre/dynComp/level -> ordered Mod1->Mod2->Delay->AmpEq->Comp->Reverb -> master gain -> limiter -> one destination, with a single shared rotary tapped post-reverb (Reverb-before-Rotary). All seven effect units are real Web Audio DSP with rendered-audio distinctness tests plus click-free crossfade bypass, and effects-routing/graph tests traverse actual node connectivity rather than metadata. Tests cross the boundary via node-web-audio-api OfflineAudioContext (~250 cases). The one real gap: only three of six piano types have a model; Clav/Digital/Misc report 'Piano not found' and play nothing where honest synthesis was allowed and would have completed the required 'six types with at least one model each' scope. Captures are clean (zero console/page errors) and surface fidelity vs the 73 reference is retained with no drift.

evidence: stage2-desktop.png: continuous red chassis, six ordered sections (Organ/Piano/center Program/Synth/Layer Effects) matching reference/nord-stage-4-73.jpg layout, 73-key E-E keybed, correct materials and OLED placements (Program + Synth only).
stage2-narrow.png: full chassis and keybed at 390x844 with no clipping or lost controls; instrument fully visible.
stage2-capture.json: desktop and narrow captures each have consoleMessages:[] and pageErrors:[].
stage2-visual-audit.md lines 10-15: no geometric drift vs stage1 (13/21/15/9/21/21 widths, 54/46 split); only intentional Phase 2 LED/OLED state changes.
effects-routing.test.ts 'the panel focus button cycles Piano A -> B -> Group and lights the FX Focus LEDs' asserts focus-cell LED data-on states through the real DOM.
effects-routing.test.ts 'Shift+On toggles Global mode ... lights the GLOBAL tag' verifies .red-tag.lit on the reverb box.
stage2-visual-audit.md lines 24-31: Piano type/Timbre/KB Touch/Dyn Comp/Unison/Acoustics LEDs, FX Focus LEDs, rotary SLOW/FAST/STOP LEDs and Program OLED bottom lines reflect canonical state.
fallback.test.ts 'selecting an unpopulated type reports Piano not found ... flashes the type LED' asserts oled-piano-line text and .led.flash.

On disk: public/samples/grand = 90 real MP3s (file: 'MPEG ADTS layer III ... 44.1 kHz Stereo', ~300KB each), upright/electric = 19 each; md5 confirms grand/upright/electric c4 and grand c4-l1/l2/l3 are all distinct files (genuinely recorded, not generated).

render-library.test.ts 'the three instruments are audibly distinct' asserts pairwise similarity < 0.8 and zero-crossing spread > 1.15 through the real OfflineAudioContext graph; 'different notes select different recorded roots' proves no uniform pitch-shifting.

IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json sampleSources declares Salamander (CC BY 3.0, 30 roots x 3 recorded velocity layers) and two MIT MIDI-JS sets with honest single-layer velocity-shaping and bank-uncertainty declarations.

GAP: library.ts INSTRUMENTS has only Grand/Upright/Electric; Clav/Digital/Misc have no model and play nothing ('Piano not found', fallback.test.ts line 65), whereas prompts/stage2.md and piano.json scope.required ('six types with at least one model each') allowed honest synthesis for those three.

layers.test.ts: enabling B doubles voice ownership (each layer owns its own voice into its own bus), noteOff releases both, and 'per-layer octave shift selects different recorded roots' checks a new zone buffer rather than a blind rate change.
graph.test.ts 'voices from both layers enter their own buses' verifies per-layer voice-gain connectivity to A.voiceBus and B.voiceBus.
layers.test.ts: per-layer selection (B Electric vs A Grand), canonical per-layer level/enable, focus follows enable, and all-notes-off cleans voices owned by both layers back to zero.
engine.ts noteOn (lines 590-595) iterates enabled layers gated by piano.sectionOn; startVoice applies layerState.octave*12 per layer (line 613).

render-piano-controls.test.ts proves rendered-audio change for velocity direction, KB Touch (Light>Heavy), timbre brightness (Soft<Off<Bright), Dyn Comp (soft raised), unison stereo width >1.5x, master volume scaling+mute, soft release decay, string resonance (>0.02 diff) and pitch bend.

engine.ts implements these on the real graph: timbre shelves (timbreGains), dynComp threshold/ratio/makeup (lines 527-532), resonance send following damper (line 535), unison detuned/panned copies (buildSampleSources lines 704-729).
piano-controls.test.ts asserts the same controls write canonical state and update live FakeGain/FakeFilter/FakeCompressor parameters (state+graph proof separate from the rendered proof).
half-pedal test: continuous CC64 keeps more tail than plain release but less than full sustain (render-piano-controls.test.ts lines 215-232).
feature-matrix piano.basic-inputs + midi.test.ts (23 cases): pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped keys with repeat suppression, CC64/CC66/CC67, hot-plug/disconnect/denied/unsupported MIDI.

render-library.test.ts 'primary sample failure produces the labeled synthesized fallback, still audible' (engineStatus 'fallback', rms > 0.003); fallback.test.ts covers total+partial failure never reporting ready.
render-piano-controls.test.ts 'Panic cuts sounding audio almost immediately' (rms drops below 0.2x); allNotesOff('panic') uses 8ms release in engine.ts.
render-effects.test.ts 'clipping protection: many simultaneous loud notes stay within full scale' (peak <= 1.0, rms > 0.05) exercises 24-note layered polyphony through the limiter.
graph.test.ts 'creates exactly one AudioContext with exactly one destination' and 'no engine path bypasses the shared master output' (single node into destination is the limiter, fed by master gain).
graph.test.ts 'wires each layer bus through the documented effect order into the master' traverses real connections voiceBus->timbre->level->mod1..reverb->master with the rotary tap post-reverb.
graph.test.ts 'parameter changes use ramped automation' confirms setTarget events (no bare set/linear) on live gains; rampTo in engine.ts uses setTargetAtTime tau=0.02.
graph.test.ts 'dispose tears the whole standing graph down and closes the context': context.closed, liveNodes()==0, all effect LFO oscillators stopped.

effects.ts implements real DSP for every unit: Mod1 (StereoPanner/LFO tremolo/ring-mod/wah envelope-follower), Mod2 (all-pass phaser/vibe, modulated-delay flanger/chorus/ensemble/spin), Delay (feedback loop with in-loop filter+analog shaper+modulated micro-delay), AmpEq (waveshaper drive + LP24/HP24 two-stage filter + 3-band EQ), Comp (DynamicsCompressor), Reverb (Convolver with generated IRs), Rotary (dual-band doppler/amp/pan with inertia).

render-effects.test.ts (28 cases) proves each family measurably changes rendered audio: tremolo fluctuation >1.3x, A-Pan side-swing >2x, phaser/chorus similarity <0.985, delay repeats+feedback length, LP24 darkening <0.5x, compressor range <0.8x, reverb tail >1.5x, rotary swing count fast>1.8x slow.
IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json: 'Every unit processes real audio through connected nodes ... no unit is a label, enum or disconnected node' -- corroborated by the connectivity assertions.
render-effects.test.ts 'All FX Off renders like the dry signal even with every unit engaged' (similarity > 0.99) confirms bypass is real, not cosmetic.

effects-routing.test.ts: per-layer focused targeting, Group copy-on-entry editing both layers, Global (Shift+On) mirroring Delay/Comp/Reverb, unit On engaging wet crossfade and bypass restoring dry (gain.value 1), dry/wet moving the actual crossfade, All FX Off bypass+restore across chains.
effects-routing.test.ts 'the Delay feedback filter/effect processes REPEATS only, never the dry path' traverses the loop to find the lowpass loop filter and asserts the dry path has no filter.

effects-routing.test.ts 'Amp/EQ To Rotary routes the layer through the single rotary instance, post-reverb' toggles toRotary/toMaster gains; engine.ts lines 549-551 gate routing on ampEq.type==='To Rotary'.

effects-routing.test.ts 'rotary speed and stop controls retarget the rotor/horn LFO frequencies with inertia' (fast>5, stop<0.1, setTarget acceleration ramp) and 'tap tempo sets the delay time from tap intervals'.

stage2-visual-audit.md lines 42-61: browser pass confirmed panel selections and effect toggles produced immediate display/LED feedback and matching live-signal change with an AnalyserNode on the real master gain (26/26 flows pass).
effects-routing.test.ts focus/global/tap-tempo tests tie panel button clicks to both LED state and oled-edit-line text (e.g. 'Delay Tempo 50x ms').
fallback.test.ts 'the app status strip and Program display surface the fallback truthfully' asserts engine-status data-status='fallback' and oled-status-line/FALLBACK.
engine.ts refreshStatus composes a truthful ready line ('Pianos ready (recorded samples) - A: ... B: ...') vs loading/fallback/error strings.
midi.test.ts covers denied/disconnected/unsupported MIDI while keyboard/pointer input keeps working (also shown in stage2-desktop.png status strip: 'MIDI permission denied').
render-library.test.ts + fallback.test.ts: total and partial asset failure enter a labeled playable synthesized fallback and never report ready; offlineAssets({fail:true}) drives the rendered proof.
render-effects.test.ts clipping-protection test (24 simultaneous velocity-1 notes, peak <= 1.0) exercises the limiter under layered polyphony.
stage2-visual-audit.md line 62: 30 fast notes settle voices back to zero with zero console errors; render-piano-controls Panic test proves rapid silence + recovery.

Clean boundaries: engine.ts (voices/layers/master), effects.ts (EffectUnit<S> shell with dry/wet+bypass), library.ts (sample specs/zone selection), boundaries.ts injectable AudioBoundary/AssetBoundary/timers.

PianoEngine.buildChannel constructs a reusable per-layer LayerChannel (bus, timbre, dynComp, level, res, ordered units, toMaster/toRotary) — extensible to Organ/Synth in Phase 3 by feeding new sources into the same buses.
Single shared rotary instance created once (createRotary) and tapped by both channels post-reverb; diagnostics() exposes real nodes only for tests, not app logic (engine.ts lines 1055-1069).
offline.ts uses node-web-audio-api OfflineAudioContext with an injected AudioBoundary; browser context/assets/MIDI/timers all remain fakeable (fakes.ts).

offline.ts renders the full engine graph through a REAL Web Audio implementation (OfflineAudioContext) decoding the bundled MP3s from disk, returning measured channels — genuine boundary crossing, not mocks.

render-library/render-effects/render-piano-controls (43 rendered cases) assert signal relationships (rms/similarity/highBandRatio/zeroCrossing) proving source distinction, control direction, effect processing, bypass and routing.

graph.test.ts and effects-routing.test.ts use FakeNode connection graphs to assert real connectivity, order, feedback loops and cleanup (reaches()/directlyConnected()), complementing the rendered proofs.
graph.test.ts dispose test verifies node/oscillator teardown and context close, and layers.test.ts verifies voice cleanup counts return to baseline.
feature-matrix.json regression.phase1 retains all 13 Phase 1 test files; ~250 total test cases across 24 files.
engine.ts bounds memory (truncateBuffer 6.5s cap), reuses shared buffers (sampleCache, pedalThump, reverb impulse Map), and ramps parameters to avoid clicks; voice GC via injected timers.
stage2-capture.json: zero console/page errors on the built artifact at both viewports; stage2-visual-audit.md reports zero console errors across the 26-flow browser pass.
Clear naming and section comments throughout effects.ts/engine.ts; a real interaction bug found and fixed in the browser pass (group-box-title pointer-events) is documented.

issues.description: Only 3 of the 6 piano types have a playable model. Clav/Digital/Misc have no bundled model and play nothing ('Piano not found'), whereas piano.json scope.required calls for 'All six piano types selectable with at least one model each' and prompts/stage2.md explicitly permits honest synthesis for Clav/Digital/Misc. The behavior is honest (it never fakes sound), but it is an incompleteness against the required scope rather than a fully realized six-type library.

Pedal noise and half-pedaling are listed under piano.json scope.excluded, yet the candidate implements both (declared as generated approximations / continuous CC64). This is truthfully labeled extra credit that works, not a violation, but it goes beyond the required scope.
